GenAiPlugin.description: Proposes new copy for one or more fields of the industry variant section the editor has open. Never saves: the result goes into the editor's field editor as an editable draft.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: Call this action to propose new copy for the section's fields. Only propose values for fieldKeys returned by GTMGetSectionContent, never invented field names. After a successful call, tell the editor plainly that nothing is saved yet and they must review the proposal in the field editor before publishing.
genAiPluginInstructions.masterLabel: Draft GTM Section Variant Copy Instructions
